rationale: The stock is trading following an acquisition announcement with a fixed exchange ratio of 0.987 EQT shares per RRC share, which mechanically tethers its valuation to the acquirer's price and compresses independent intraday range ($0.53 range today after yesterday's surge). Without visibility into the acquirer's real-time order flow, taking a directional position exposes capital to unhedged merger-arbitrage mechanics rather than standalone momentum.
